<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Garena</title>
<style>
* { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

body {
  background: black; /* Fondo negro */
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  height: 100vh;
  gap: 1.5rem;
}

.garena-svg {
  width: 160px;
  height: auto;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 5px rgba(255,0,0,0,4))
}

/* Dragón rojo */
#garena-path {
  fill: transparent;
  stroke: #ff0000;
  stroke-width: 3;
  stroke-linecap: round;
  stroke-linejoin: round;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 0 3px rgba(255,0,0,0,3))
 
  stroke-dasharray: 0;
  stroke-dashoffset: 0;
  transition: fill 1s ease-in;
  
  /* 6s total: 3s trazar + 1s relleno + 1s desintegrar + 1s pausa */
  animation: garenaLoop 6s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes garenaLoop {
 0% {
   stroke-dashoffset: var(--path-length);
   fill: transparent;
   fill-opacity: 0; /* <-- AGREGA ESTO */
  }
 52% { /* 4s - termina de trazarse */
   stroke-dashoffset: 0;
   fill: #ff0000;
   fill-opacity: 0; /* <-- EMPIEZA INVISIBLE */
 }
  52% { /* 3.12s - empieza a llenar al toque */
   fill: #ff0000;
   fill-opacity: 0.5; /* Ya empieza a verse */
  }
  60% { /* 3.24s - 0.2s para llenar */
   stroke-dashoffset: 0;
   fill: #ff0000;
   fill-opacity: 0.9; /* <-- SE LLENA AQUÍ */
 }
 83% {
   stroke-dashoffset: 0;
   fill: #ff0000;
   fill-opacity: 0.9; /* <-- SE QUEDA LLENO */
 }
 100% {
   stroke-dashoffset: var(--path-length);
   fill: transparent;
   fill-opacity: 0; /* <-- SE DESVANECE */
 }
  }

/* Texto GARENA - mismo timing exacto */
.garena-text {
letter-spacing: 3px; /* 4px es mucho, 3px queda más pro */
  font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
  font-size: 2.5rem;
  font-weight: 900;
  color: #00ff00;
text-shadow: 4px 4px 6px rgba(0,170,255,0.6);
opacity: 0;
animation: textLoop 6s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94) infinite;
}

@keyframes garenaLoop {
 0% {
   stroke-dashoffset: var(--path-length);
   fill: transparent;
   fill-opacity: 0;
 }
 52% { /* 3.38s - termina de trazarse */
   stroke-dashoffset: 0;
   fill: #ff0000;
   fill-opacity: 0;
 }
 52% {
   fill: #ff0000;
   fill-opacity: 0.5;
 }
 60% { /* 3.9s - se llena */
   stroke-dashoffset: 0;
   fill: #ff0000;
   fill-opacity: 0.9;
 }
 92.3% { /* 6s - se queda lleno + borrado esperando */
   stroke-dashoffset: var(--path-length);
   fill: transparent;
   fill-opacity: 0;
 }
 100% { /* 6.5s - reset instantáneo pa' que no se vea el salto */
   stroke-dashoffset: var(--path-length);
   fill: transparent;
   fill-opacity: 0;
 }
  }
</style>
</head>
